newsitem.title: UK: Mexico's MAS Air plans London-Mexico cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's MAS Air plans London-Mexico cargo flights.

text.p: Mexican all-cargo carrier Aerotransportes MAS de Carga SA de CV (MAS Air) will operate five weekly London Stansted-Mexico City-Guadalajara flights from May 17, said its UK agent Air Logistics.
It added that a 38-tonne capacity hushkitted Boeing 707-320C would be used and that further flights would depend on the success of the initial series.
Mark Lingham, Air Logistics' cargo operations controller, told Reuters he expected that general cargo would be carried, although he said that full-flight charter bookings would be accepted.
Air Logistics, which has represented MAS Air in the UK for more than a year, said it had recently opened a new office at London Heathrow airport. Its headquarters is at East Midlands airport.

Apart from the 707F, MAS Air also operates a DC-8-71 freighter and the destinations it serves with cargo charter flights include Bogota, Lima, Los Angeles, Miami and New York. - euters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706; fax +5017
